title: Minecraft item model definition
description: Defines model, display and override rules for items.

parent.title: Parent
parent.description: Inherit from another model file, specified as a namespace ID. When both parent and elements are set, this model's elements will override the parent model's elements.

textures.title: Textures
textures.description: Defines the block particle texture and texture variables used by the model. Values can be a texture file path (namespace ID) or another texture variable.

particle.title: Particle
particle.description: The particle texture for the block. Also used when the player is inside a nether portal. Note: block breaking particles for non-model-rendered blocks may be hardcoded.

^layer[0-9]{1,}$.description: Used only to specify item icons in the inventory. Multiple layers are allowed (e.g. spawn eggs), but the number of possible layers per item is hardcoded. Must be used with builtin/generated.

additionalProperties.description: Defines a texture variable and assigns a texture.

elements.title: Elements
elements.description: Lists all elements of the model. These elements can only be cuboids. When both parent and elements are set, this model's elements will override the parent model's elements.

gui_light.title: GUI Light
gui_light.description: Used only in GUIs. Can be front or side. When set to side, the model is rendered as a cuboid. When set to front, the model is rendered as a flat texture filling the entire slot.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Specifies different models to override based on item predicate conditions. Deprecated since Java Edition 1.21.4 in favor of item model mappings in assets/<namespace>/items/*.json.
overrides.deprecationMessage: models/item overrides are deprecated in Java Edition 1.21.4+. Use item model mappings in the items directory instead.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: Determines the compass angle, expressed as a decimal value less than 1.

blocking.title: Blocking
blocking.description: Determines whether the shield is in blocking state. 1 when blocking.

broken.title: Broken
broken.description: Determines whether the elytra is broken. 1 when broken.

cast.title: Cast
cast.description: Determines whether the fishing rod has been cast. 1 when cast.

cooldown.title: Cooldown
cooldown.description: Determines the remaining cooldown time of an ender pearl/chorus fruit, expressed as a decimal value between 0 and 1.

damage.title: Damage value
damage.description: Determines the damage level of a durable item, expressed as a decimal value between 0 and 1.

damaged.title: Damaged
damaged.description: Determines whether a durable item is damaged. 1 when damaged. If the item has the Unbreakable tag, this value is 0 and the damage value can be non-zero.

lefthanded.title: Left-handed
lefthanded.description: Specifies the model used by left-handed players, affecting its appearance in the inventory and when held or worn.

pull.title: Pull
pull.description: Determines how far the bow has been pulled, expressed as a decimal value between 0 and 1. 0 when not pulled, 1 when fully pulled.

pulling.title: Pulling
pulling.description: Determines whether the bow is being pulled. 1 when pulled.

throwing.title: Throwing
throwing.description: Used for tridents to determine whether the trident is about to be thrown. 1 when ready to throw.

time.title: Time
time.description: Determines the clock time, expressed as a decimal value between 0 and 1.

custom_model_data.title: Custom model data
custom_model_data.description: Used for items with custom models, expressed as an integer.

model.title: Model
model.description: The path to the model file to use when the condition is met, specified as a namespace ID.
